text: Five versions. Now — the crewman's song, whole, the way he gave it to us. We cleaned it, we walked it around the room, we gave it five different hearts. Now we give it back to him.
Bring it in, bring it in.
Watch it splash, watch it slish.
Lead it 'round like a pet on a leash.
He's reaching for his gaff, and it's only a pink.
We are all watching and waiting.
Crewman — this one's yours. Every hand on the line. Good night from the Compass Head Radio Hour.
